about: Hand-chosen map from Kolej MARA Kulim menu items (index into MENU.foods in js/hw-01-menu-data.js) to USDA FoodData Central SR Legacy foods. Only items that correspond to ONE USDA food with a clear edible portion are mapped; mixed dishes, drinks of unknown recipe and anything whose grams are unknown are left out on purpose. match: 'direct' = the same food; 'close' = the same kind of food but a different variety, brand or preparation. Read by tools/build_menu_nutrients.py, which takes every number from the USDA tables.

items.gramsNote: The menu says '1/2 Biji x 30g'; its 45 kcal matches 30 g of hard-boiled egg (155 kcal per 100 g), so 30 g is taken as the whole serving.
